name: Banh dap
summary: A crisp grilled rice-paper sheet clapped onto a soft steamed one, so it shatters when you press the middle. Dip it in anchovy sauce with a little sugar, fried-shallot oil or pineapple and lime, and chili.
origin: Cẩm Nam, the village across the river from Hoi An’s old town. Da Nang makes its own bánh tráng đập.
texture: Both sheets are white rice soaked two to three hours. The crisp sheet is grilled; the inner sheet is soft. Press the middle so the crisp sheet shatters onto the soft one.
taste: The 30 May 2023 dip is mắm cái from Cửa Đại anchovy, a little sugar, and fried-shallot oil, with fresh chili or chili sauce if you want heat.

Danang Fantasticity’s Hội An section uses mắm nêm from anchovy with a little sugar, pineapple or lime, and red chili. The conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 list also spreads the soft sheet with scallion fat, shrimp powder, or pork. All three stay.
howToEat: Press the cracker with your hand, then dip, or spoon the sauce over.
Eat it with hến xào when the stall sets the clams beside it.
seoTitle: Banh dap — the Cẩm Nam cracker in Hoi An
seoDescription: Bánh đập in Cẩm Nam is a crisp rice-paper sheet clapped to a soft one. Break it by hand. Dip it in anchovy sauce.
